newsitem.title: GERMANY: Varig to add 0.15 mark/kg fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Varig to add 0.15 mark/kg fuel surcharge.

text.p: Brazilian national carrier Varig said it will apply an ex-Germany cargo fuel surcharge of 0.15 marks per kilogramme from November 15.
The charge matches similar fuel surcharges set by Lufthansa Cargo, Air France, KLM Royal Dutch Airlines, Swissair and Cargolux.
The airlines blame the surcharge on the sharp increase in the cost of jet fuel since July.
A Varig spokesman told Reuters: "We cannot avoid doing this but we will introduce the surcharge from November 15 to give agents time to inform their clients."
The fuel price rise had cost Varig millions of dollars in additional costs in recent months, he said.
The spokesman said: "It is an ex-Germany rise only at present, but we are discussing whether to apply it in Europe or across the company."
Varig would drop the surcharge as soon as fuel prices retured to normal levels, the spokesman said. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
